To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that

(i) higher fiscal transparency reduces borrowing costs for EMs and increases foreign demand for their debt; (ii) the effect on borrowing costs is driven by the openness of the budget and fiscal accountability; (iii) the effect on foreign demand is driven by data availability; and (iv) the effects of fiscal accountability are not driven by the availability of data.
